item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the winter monsoon, the weather is cold over the coast of Guangdong today. It will be cloudy, rainy and windy with the weather remaining relatively cold over the coast of southern China tomorrow and during the Lunar New Year holidays.

Date/Month: 30/01 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cold in the morning. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 12 - 17 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 31/01 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. Cold in the morning.
Temp range: 12 - 16 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 01/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. It will be cold.
Temp range: 12 - 15 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
